raw_question_text: Draw the front view, top view, and side view of the object shown in Figure.1.
The front and top views of an object are shown in Figure.2. Draw its isometric projection.

A cylinder of 50 mm base diameter and axis 70 mm long rests on its base in the HP. A square cutout of 35 mm side is drilled through the cylinder such that the axis of cutout is perpendicular to the axis of the cylinder. The center of the cutout is 35 mm above HP and 15 mm away from the axis of cylinder. Two faces of the cutout are equally inclined to HP. Develop the lateral surfaces.
